description: Generate a performable control panel from an existing node/COMP's primitive parameters. It reads source_path, infers sliders/toggles/text fields, appends them as custom parameters on comp_path (default source_path), and optionally binds each control back to the source parameter. Use when a generated component has useful parameters but no playable UI yet.

bind.description: Bind generated controls back to source_path parameters.

comp_path.description: COMP that receives the generated control panel. Defaults to source_path.

max_controls.description: Maximum inferred controls when parameters is omitted.

page.description: Custom-parameter page name for the controls.

parameters.description: Only expose these parameter names. Omit to infer useful primitive parameters.

source_path.description: Node or COMP whose parameters should become controls.

name: auto_ui_from_params
title: Auto UI from parameters
